response.justification: While the candidate is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with a strong background in web development, distributed systems, and Node.js/TypeScript, they lack the recent and extensive C++ experience required for this role. Furthermore, they do not possess the necessary background in industrial automation, IoT protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA), or secure engineering practices (IEC 62443) central to the position.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) with a strong focus on architecture, microservices, and event-driven systems.
Deep knowledge of modern software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD, and agile methodologies.
Demonstrated leadership and mentoring abilities, including organizing workshops, refactoring dojos, and founding an open-source platform.
concerns: Severe lack of recent C++ and STL experience, with only a brief 7-month stint using C/C++ in 2014-2015.
No demonstrated experience with industrial automation protocols (MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA) or IoT application development.
Missing required expertise in industrial cybersecurity standards, specifically IEC 62443 and formal Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices.
